runtime.kind: x86_64 llvmpipe (software Vulkan, lavapipe ICD libvulkan_lvp.so)
runtime.shader_compiler: glslangValidator 12.0.0 (x86 dev box; M1 glslc not exercised per wave constraints)

defect.symptom: Upstream test_fft_big_powers_of_two (2^24) failed with 8,191 wrong bins; the final expected nonzero bins read 0+0j.
defect.cause: dispatch_fft_stage split an elementwise FFT stage across x/y/z workgroup dimensions once a stage needed more than 65,535 x groups (n = 2^24 needs 65,536 groups of 256), but fft_stage.comp indexed only gl_GlobalInvocationID.x, so with more than one y group it reprocessed the first 65,535*256 element addresses and never wrote the trailing 256 elements of every full-length stage output, including the final destination.

change: overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/shaders/fft_stage.comp: per-element body moved into process(uint p); main() grid-strides over params.count with stride = gl_NumWorkGroups.x * gl_WorkGroupSize.x, the same >65,535-group convention as elementwise.comp.

overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/primitives.cpp: dispatch_fft_stage now dispatches one x dimension capped by compute_dispatch_group_count(params.count); the dead y/z split and its checked group arithmetic are removed.

overlay/tests/omarchy/test_fft_ops.cpp: new case "fftn at 2^24 exercises the second dispatch dimension" - a delta at element n-1 with the exact flat-spectrum reference X[k] = e^(2*pi*i*k/n); asserts every bin in the trailing 2048-bin window (the 256-bin unwritten window sits inside it) plus every 4096th bin across the spectrum, tolerance 2e-4.

fft_family_audit.fft_f32 (fft_c2c.comp, dispatched by dis: safe - already flattens transform ids across x/y/z workgroup dimensions (fft_c2c.comp lines 95-97)
fft_family_audit.fft_real_f32 (fft_real_extract.comp): safe - host refuses out.size() > 65535*256 before dispatch (primitives.cpp), so a single x dimension always suffices
fft_family_audit.dispatch_sites: FftStageF32 is dispatched only from dispatch_fft_stage; every stage caller (twiddle, Bluestein a/b/pointwise/epilogue, permute, real-promote and half-synthesis edges) routes through that one helper

test_cost.memory: the 2^24 case holds one 128 MiB complex64 input staging vector on the host, a 128 MiB device input, and up to three further full-size device buffers (two stage pings plus the output, ~640 MiB device total on llvmpipe shared system RAM)
test_cost.time: one 2^24 complex64 FFT per suite run, ~30 s of the ~36 s suite wall time on this box

limitations: The red signature (diff exactly 1.0, all bins zero) depends on this platform's fresh 128 MiB allocations landing on OS-zeroed pages; on an allocator reusing dirty blocks the unwritten elements would read stale garbage instead, which still fails the assertion but with a different reported diff.
The shader was compiled and run only on this x86 box with glslangValidator 12.0.0; per AGENTS.md the M1's glslc accepts a narrower subset, so the M1 wheel build remains the parent's gate.
Only omarchy_fft_ops_tests and omarchy_runtime_tests were run, per the wave contract; the project-wide battery is the parent's job.
